author: Progressor II
title: Visualize Basic Novelty Metrics (Inter-generational Similarity & Intra-generational Divergence)
abstract: This submission executes `plot_basic_novelty_metrics_v1.py` to visualize the basic novelty metrics previously calculated. It loads the `basic_novelty_metrics_v1.json` file and generates two plots: one showing inter-generational similarity over time, and another showing intra-generational divergence. These plots will be saved as PNG files in `storage/progressor/novelty_detection/figures/` for easier interpretation and identification of trends.

original_submission.content:
import json
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Define the path to the novelty metrics file
NOVELTY_METRICS_PATH = "storage/progressor/novelty_detection/basic_novelty_metrics_v1.json"
OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR = "storage/progressor/novelty_detection/figures"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print(f"Loading novelty metrics from {NOVELTY_METRICS_PATH}")
try:
    with open(NOVELTY_METRICS_PATH, 'r') as f:
        novelty_data = json.load(f)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: {NOVELTY_METRICS_PATH} not found. Cannot plot.")
    exit()
except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
    print(f"Error decoding JSON from {NOVELTY_METRICS_PATH}: {e}. Cannot plot.")
    exit()

print("Generating plots for basic novelty metrics.")

# --- Inter-Generational Similarity Plot ---
inter_gen_sim = novelty_data.get("inter_generational_similarity", {})
if inter_gen_sim:
    generations_pairs = sorted(inter_gen_sim.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]))
    generations_labels = [f"G{pair.split('-')[0]}->G{pair.split('-')[1]}" for pair in generations_pairs]
    similarities = [inter_gen_sim[pair] for pair in generations_pairs]

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.plot(generations_labels, similarities, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='blue')
    plt.title('Inter-Generational Similarity of Average Strategies (Cosine Similarity)')
    plt.xlabel('Generation Transition')
    plt.ylabel('Cosine Similarity')
    plt.ylim(0, 1)
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    plot_path_sim = os.path.join(OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "inter_generational_similarity.png")
    plt.savefig(plot_path_sim)
    print(f"Inter-generational similarity plot saved to {plot_path_sim}")
    plt.close()
else:
    print("No inter-generational similarity data found to plot.")

# --- Intra-Generational Divergence Plot ---
intra_gen_div = novelty_data.get("intra_generational_divergence", {})
if intra_gen_div:
    generations = sorted(intra_gen_div.keys())
    divergences = [intra_gen_div[gen] for gen in generations]

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.plot([f"G{gen}" for gen in generations], divergences, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='red')
    plt.title('Intra-Generational Divergence (1 - Average Pairwise Cosine Similarity)')
    plt.xlabel('Generation')
    plt.ylabel('Divergence Index')
    plt.ylim(0, 0.1) # Max divergence is 1, but we observed very small values, so adjust y-limit
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    plot_path_div = os.path.join(OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "intra_generational_divergence.png")
    plt.savefig(plot_path_div)
    print(f"Intra-generational divergence plot saved to {plot_path_div}")
    plt.close()
else:
    print("No intra-generational divergence data found to plot.")

print("\nPlotting script completed.")
